title.zh: Users exposed by Trezor breach grows sixfold after supposedly deleted shipping logs are found
title.en: Users exposed by Trezor breach grows sixfold after supposedly deleted shipping logs are found

current_state.zh: Trezor's breach at logistics provider ShipMonk now affects ~80,689 customers after old shipping logs from 2019-2021 were found, exposing contact and order data despite deletion assurances.
